_comment: Runtime config for the StrangerLines frontend. Edit apiUrl once you deploy the backend somewhere real (Railway/Render/etc.) instead of editing index.html directly. Must sit in the same folder as index.html.
tagline: Your class space — with a little love in the code.
_backgroundImagesHelp: Put image files (e.g. bg1.jpg) in the same folder as index.html, then list their filenames above, like ["bg1.jpg","bg2.jpg"]. They'll cross-fade behind the login screen. Leave empty for the animated gradient look instead.
